name: taskcut
description: Compacts when the work moves on from one sub-task to the next instead of when the context window fills, including in the middle of a long turn. Once the context is past a floor, a model judges each step, reading what you asked for and where Claude has got to but never any tool output, for whether the work moves on from a finished piece to another; if it does, taskcut runs Claude Code's own compaction. Below the floor it does nothing and costs nothing.

floorPercent.title: Context % before taskcut acts
floorPercent.description: Leave empty for 35 (0–100). Below this context fill, taskcut does nothing. Lower compacts sooner and more often; each compaction clears the prompt cache. 0 checks every step.

model.title: Model that spots task switches
model.description: Leave empty for sonnet. Decides whether Claude has moved on to the next task. haiku is cheaper but misses about half. An alias or a full model id.
